rci1_using_msad.detail: Single site; all data collected on a single 1.5T Siemens MAGNETOM Sonata scanner in the Oslo area of Norway
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Structural scans were obtained on a 1.5 Tesla Siemens MAGNETOM Sonata scanner (Siemens Medical Solutions, Erlangen, Germany) using a standard head coil."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference cohort recruited as part of the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study, which is an established public dataset
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "All participants were recruited as part of the Thematically Organized Psychosis study from October 27, 2004, to October 17, 2012."

rci3_epd_name.detail: Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study; healthy controls randomly sampled from national population registries in the Oslo area
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "All participants were recruited as part of the Thematically Organized Psychosis study"

rci5_n.detail: Overall HC cohort used identically for all 4 normative models; 10-fold CV for performance estimation, final model trained on all 256 HC then applied to patients
rci5_n.location: Wolfers2018.pdf.md: Results, L81; yoi180064supp1_prod.pdf.md: eTable 1, L95-98

rci6_sex.detail: Overall phase; male_n = 140 (54.7%) reported directly; female_n = 256 - 140 = 116 (45.3%) estimated from total N minus reported male_n; same cohort for all models

rci7_age.detail: Overall phase; age in years; reported directly for healthy individuals; same cohort for all models
